data.one_liner: Asynchronous state management for server data with automatic caching and background updates.
data.what_it_does: Fetches, caches, and synchronizes server data in Flutter applications, providing automatic request deduplication, background refetching, and stale-while-revalidate capabilities. It is inspired by TanStack Query and utilizes Flutter hooks.
use_when: You want automatic caching and background refetching for remote server data
You are already using flutter_hooks in your application
avoid_when: You are not using flutter_hooks and prefer traditional state management architectures
You are dealing with simple local state that does not involve network requests
strengths: Automatic caching and stale time configuration
Request deduplication for shared network requests
Built-in support for infinite pagination and optimistic updates
weaknesses: Requires flutter_hooks for its core API widgets/functions
Relatively new package with evolving APIs before v1.0.0

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a robust, global provider-based dependency injection and state management solution without relying strictly on flutter_hooks.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a strict event-driven state management pattern with predictable state transitions.
